steps.name: Check out the protected beta tag
Resolve the tag and successful beta run
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch --no-tags origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
commit="$(git rev-list -n 1 "refs/tags/$ORLIX_RELEASE_TAG")"
test -n "$commit"
run_id="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/testflight-beta.yml/runs?event=push&status=success&head_sha=$commit" --jq '.workflow_runs[0].id // empty')"
test -n "$run_id" || { echo "No successful beta workflow exists for $ORLIX_RELEASE_TAG at $commit" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "commit=$commit" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "run_id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "ORLIX_RELEASE_COMMIT=$commit" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "ORLIX_RELEASE_RUN_ID=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Set up Ruby and pinned Fastlane
Materialize App Store Connect credentials
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test -n "$APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY"
umask 077
private_key="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
export ORLIX_FASTLANE_API_KEY_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/appstore-api-key.json"
printf '%s' "$APPSTORE_API_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$private_key"
export private_key
ruby -rjson -e 'File.write(ENV.fetch("ORLIX_FASTLANE_API_KEY_PATH"), JSON.pretty_generate({key_id: ENV.fetch("APPSTORE_API_KEY_ID"), issuer_id: ENV.fetch("APPSTORE_ISSUER_ID"), key_filepath: ENV.fetch("private_key"), in_house: false}))'
echo "ORLIX_FASTLANE_API_KEY_PATH=$ORLIX_FASTLANE_API_KEY_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Prepare both simulator runtimes
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Caches/Orlix/ios15-runtime"
sudo xcodes runtimes install "iOS 15.5" --architecture arm64 --directory "$HOME/Library/Caches/Orlix/ios15-runtime" --keep-archive --no-color
current_runtime_id="$(xcrun simctl list runtimes -j | jq -r '.runtimes[] | select(.version == "26.5" and .isAvailable == true) | .identifier' | head -n 1)"
ios15_runtime_id="$(xcrun simctl list runtimes -j | jq -r '.runtimes[] | select(.version == "15.5" and .isAvailable == true) | .identifier' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$current_runtime_id"
test -n "$ios15_runtime_id"
device_type="com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimDeviceType.iPhone-13"
xcrun simctl list devicetypes -j | jq -e --arg identifier "$device_type" '.devicetypes[] | select(.identifier == $identifier)' >/dev/null
current_id="$(xcrun simctl create "Orlix current CI" "$device_type" "$current_runtime_id")"
ios15_id="$(xcrun simctl create "Orlix iOS 15.5 CI" "$device_type" "$ios15_runtime_id")"
test -n "$current_id"
test -n "$ios15_id"
xcrun simctl boot "$current_id"
xcrun simctl boot "$ios15_id"
xcrun simctl bootstatus "$current_id" -b
xcrun simctl bootstatus "$ios15_id" -b
{
  echo "ORLIX_CURRENT_SIMULATOR_ID=$current_id"
  echo "ORLIX_CURRENT_SIMULATOR_VERSION=26.5"
  echo "ORLIX_IOS15_SIMULATOR_ID=$ios15_id"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Reconstruct the signed buildset from source

brew list cosign >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install cosign

printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | oras login ghcr.io --registry-config "$ORLIX_ORAS_REGISTRY_CONFIG" -u "$GITHUB_ACTOR" --password-stdin
make __bazel-reconstruct-source

steps.name: Cancel when macos-26 stays queued
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
  job_status="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/jobs" --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name == "Dual-build promote") | .status' | head -n 1)"
  case "$job_status" in
    in_progress|completed)
      echo "macos-26 job is $job_status"
      exit 0
      ;;
  esac
  sleep 30
done
gh run cancel "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
echo "cancelled: macos-26 job still queued after 10 minutes"
exit 1

test "$(xcodebuild -version | sed -n '2p')" = "Build version 17F113"

steps.name: Sign and publish the buildset to GHCR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY}" ]; then
  echo "ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY is required; promotion failed"
  exit 1
fi
brew list cosign >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install cosign
brew list oras >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install oras
key_path="${ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY#file://}"
if [ ! -f "$key_path" ]; then
  key_path="${RUNNER_TEMP}/orlix-cosign.key"
  printf '%s\n' "$ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY" > "$key_path"
  chmod 600 "$key_path"
fi
export ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY="file://${key_path}"
export COSIGN_PASSWORD="${ORLIX_COSIGN_KEY_PASSWORD}"
cosign public-key --key "$key_path" > "$key_path.pub"
export ORLIX_COSIGN_PUB="$key_path.pub"
printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | oras login ghcr.io --registry-config "$ORLIX_ORAS_REGISTRY_CONFIG" -u "${GITHUB_ACTOR}" --password-stdin
for component in uapi mlibc rootfs kernel-release-iphoneos kernel-release-iphonesimulator kernel-development-iphoneos kernel-development-iphonesimulator; do
  make "__bazel-publish-${component}"
done
make __bazel-lock-proposal

steps.name: Restore trusted reviewer policy from the base revision
steps.run:
git fetch --depth 1 origin "$BASE_SHA"
git checkout "$BASE_SHA" -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md

with.custom_instructions:
Follow AGENTS.md from the pull request base revision. Orlix compiles
upstream Linux into an iOS-hosted kernel. Do not suggest edits to
generated trees under Build/. Do not move Linux policy into
OrlixHostAdapter. Do not invent a parallel OrlixKit API. Fail loud
when evidence is missing.

steps.name: Install pinned RuleSync
steps.run:
version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .rulesync/VERSION)"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/dyoshikawa/rulesync/releases/download/v${version}/rulesync-linux-x64" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rulesync"
printf '%s  %s\n' a31f7861d70a1092748108a7b494c0f7c845166e7495b51b7e032a200bf07dea "$RUNNER_TEMP/rulesync" | sha256sum --check -
chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/rulesync"
test "$("$RUNNER_TEMP/rulesync" --version)" = "$version"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Prepare generated branch
steps.run:
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
source_sha="$GITHUB_SHA"
branch="automation/rulesync-${source_sha}"
version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .rulesync/VERSION)"
existing="$(gh pr list --repo rudironsoni/Orlix --head "$branch" --base main --state all --json number,state --jq 'if length == 0 then empty else .[0] | [.number, .state] | @tsv end')"
if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
  IFS=$'\t' read -r existing_pr existing_state <<< "$existing"
  if [ "$existing_state" = "MERGED" ]; then
    echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    exit 0
  fi
  test "$existing_state" = "OPEN"
  echo "existing-pr=$existing_pr" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi
echo "branch=$branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "refs/heads/${branch}" >/dev/null; then
  git fetch origin "refs/heads/${branch}:refs/remotes/origin/${branch}"
  branch_sha="$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/${branch}")"
  test "$(git rev-parse "${branch_sha}^")" = "$source_sha"
  test "$(git rev-list --count "${source_sha}..${branch_sha}")" = "1"
  git diff --quiet "$branch_sha" --
  exit 0
fi
git config user.name "RuleSync CI"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git commit -m "chore: generate agent files" -m "source-revision: ${source_sha}" -m "rulesync-version: ${version}"
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}"

steps.name: Create or reuse generated pull request
steps.run:
pr_number="$EXISTING_PR"
if [ -z "$pr_number" ]; then
  body="$RUNNER_TEMP/rulesync-generated-pr.md"
  printf "rulesync-generated: true\nsource-revision: %s\nrulesync-version: 16.26.1\n" "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$body"
  pr_url="$(gh pr create --repo rudironsoni/Orlix --base main --head "$BRANCH" --title "chore: generate RuleSync output" --body-file "$body")"
  pr_number="$(gh pr view "$pr_url" --repo rudironsoni/Orlix --json number --jq .number)"
fi
echo "number=$pr_number" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Verify generated pull request
steps.run:
head_sha="$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo rudironsoni/Orlix --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)"
make agent-rules-generated-pr-check PR_NUMBER="$PR_NUMBER" SOURCE_REVISION="$GITHUB_SHA" HEAD_REVISION="$head_sha"
echo "head_sha=$head_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Publish verified status
steps.run:
gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/statuses/${HEAD_SHA}" \
  -f state=success \
  -f context="RuleSync generated output guard" \
  -f description="Exact RuleSync regeneration matched" \
  -f target_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

steps.name: Wait for pull-request guard
steps.run:
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  conclusion="$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo rudironsoni/Orlix --json statusCheckRollup --jq '[.statusCheckRollup[] | select(.__typename == "CheckRun" and .name == "RuleSync generated output guard" and .workflowName == "RuleSync generated output guard")][-1].conclusion // ""')"
  case "$conclusion" in
    SUCCESS) exit 0 ;;
    ACTION_REQUIRED|CANCELLED|FAILURE|STALE|STARTUP_FAILURE|TIMED_OUT) exit 1 ;;
  esac
  sleep 5
done
exit 1
